# crosswork_l2vpn_vpn_services (Data Source)

This data source can read an L2VPN service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_l2vpn_vpn_services" "example" {
  id     = "cwtest-l2"
  vpn_id = "cwtest-l2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `vpn_id` (String) Name of the service. Letters, digits, `_` and `-`, at most 32 characters.

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `auto_evi_id` (Boolean) Takes the EVPN instance id from the pool of the L2VPN id pools. Set to `true` or leave unset; not with `evi_id`.
- `auto_evi_source` (Boolean) Takes the EVPN VPWS source id from the pool of the L2VPN id pools. Set to `true` or leave unset; not with `evi_source`.
- `auto_evi_target` (Boolean) Takes the EVPN VPWS target id from the pool of the L2VPN id pools. Set to `true` or leave unset; not with `evi_target`.
- `evi_id` (Number) EVPN instance id. Use `auto_evi_id` for a number from the pool.
- `evi_source` (Number) EVPN VPWS source id
- `evi_target` (Number) EVPN VPWS target id
- `service_assurance_monitoring_state` (String) Monitoring state. `pause` can be set only while the state is `enable`.
- `service_assurance_preservation` (String) What happens to the monitoring data when the service is removed
- `service_assurance_profile_name` (String) Service assurance profile, which has to exist in Crosswork (the name of a system profile ends in a space and `system`)
- `service_assurance_rule_name` (String) Service assurance rule, which has to exist in Crosswork
- `vpn_nodes` (Attributes List) The nodes of the service. A service needs two nodes, and NSO refuses one with fewer. The example shows only one node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_nodes))
- `vpn_type` (String) Type of the service

<a id="nestedatt--vpn_nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_nodes`

Read-Only:

- `multi_home_ethernet_segment_identifier` (String) Ethernet segment identifier of the access, nine bytes in hexadecimal separated by dots. The device gets it as an EVPN ethernet segment of the interface.
- `odn_route_policies` (Set of String) L2VPN route policies of the on-demand mapping.
- `sr_policy` (String) Name of an SR policy that carries the traffic.
- `sr_policy_fallback` (String) What the pseudowire does when the policy is down
- `vpn_network_accesses` (Attributes List) Accesses of the node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses))
- `vpn_node_id` (String) Name of a device in the Crosswork inventory that is onboarded to NSO

<a id="nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_nodes.vpn_network_accesses`

Read-Only:

- `cvlan_id` (Number) VLAN of the dot1q sub-interface
- `description` (String) Description of the access
- `encapsulation_type` (String) Encapsulation type, the same on both nodes
- `id` (String) Identifier of the access
- `interface_id` (String) Interface of the access. A dot1q access becomes a sub-interface.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the access.
- `oam_id_type` (String) Kind of the maintenance association id
- `oam_maid` (String) Maintenance association id, equal on both nodes
- `oam_md_level` (Number) Maintenance domain level
- `oam_md_name` (String) Maintenance domain name of the Ethernet OAM. Needs the other OAM attributes, on both nodes.
- `oam_mep_id` (Number) Maintenance end point id
- `oam_message_period` (String) Period of the continuity check messages.
- `oam_y1731_profiles` (Attributes List) Y.1731 profiles of the access, at most one delay and one loss profile (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses--oam_y1731_profiles))
- `qos_profiles` (Attributes List) QoS profiles of the access (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses--qos_profiles))
- `tag_operation_pop` (String) Number of tags that the access removes. Only one of pop, push and translate.
- `tag_operation_push` (Boolean) The access pushes the tag of `tag_operation_tag`. Set to `true` or leave unset.
- `tag_operation_tag` (Number) Tag that push or translate uses
- `tag_operation_translate` (String) The access translates the tag into the tag of `tag_operation_tag`

<a id="nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses--oam_y1731_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_nodes.vpn_network_accesses.oam_y1731_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of a Y.1731 profile
- `schedule_duration` (String) Minutes that the operations last, 1 to 1440, or `forever`; replaces the duration of the profile
- `schedule_interval` (Number) Minutes between the operations; replaces the interval of the profile


<a id="nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses--qos_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_nodes.vpn_network_accesses.qos_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `direction` (String) wan-to-site is the input and site-to-wan the output of the interface
- `profile` (String) Name of a QoS profile id; the device needs a policy-map of that name
